protocol.selection_split: inner 80/20 split of each series' train window: fit on the first 80%, validate on the last 20% (mirrors the synthetic HPO slice); the outer test split is never touched during selection
protocol.objective: range-F1 of the budgeted alert stream (dedup + per-series cooldown)
protocol.aggregation: mean over all 12 series including non-evaluable ones (0), averaged over the family's two feature sets (24 runs per point)
protocol.tie_break: higher validation range-F1; then fewer budgeted alerts; then the default point; then lower budget; then shorter cooldown

stream_definitions.deduped: contiguous above-threshold runs fire one episode alert at the run's max-score minute
stream_definitions.budgeted: deduped episodes plus the family's selected per-series cooldown
